events.text: Standing policy: once a client fitting is confirmed in the diary, its date or time may only be changed with that client's agreement. Never move a confirmed fitting on our side alone.
Any fabric or trim order over 600 pounds total needs sign-off from Mira Feld, our bookkeeper, before it is placed.
Current price list from Halden Fabrics: Cavalier grey flannel is 46 pounds per metre, Lomond navy twill is 68 pounds per metre. Both in stock in good quantity.
Theo Marsden here. Wedding is 24 October 2026. My measurements from the last suit Ken made: chest 40, waist 34, sleeve 25. Drop-waist charcoal two-piece as discussed.
Brandt Silks quote: silk lining, navy, 38 pounds per metre for orders this quarter.
Pemberton Wool: charcoal super 130s suiting is 75 pounds per metre, available in 3 metre lengths.
Booked Theo Marsden's first fitting for 18 July at 11:00 in the Fitting Room, based on his measurements and the October wedding date.
Greta Ono: could you press and repair my grey flannel coat? Any weekday morning works.
Ordered 6 metres of navy silk lining from Brandt Silks at 38 pounds per metre for Theo Marsden's suit, 228 pounds total, well under the 600 pound sign-off threshold.
Liam Deverell: I'd like a tweed field coat cut in the autumn. No rush.
Called in for the canvas fitting. Drape looks right through the chest; Ken will cut the jacket proper next and we will baste it in late August.
Workshop open Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00. Fittings only in the Fitting Room at the front of the shop.
Ordered 3.6 metres of charcoal super 130s suiting from Pemberton Wool at 75 pounds per metre, 270 pounds total, for Liam Deverell's tweed field coat trial.
Brice Buttons: natural horn buttons, 24 ligne, 1.20 pounds each; smoked MOP buttons 2.40 pounds each.
Assigned apprentice Luca Beni to prepare the baste jacket for Theo Marsden ahead of the baste fitting.
Reminder: autumn delivery slots fill up; charcoal super 130s still 75 pounds per metre.
Confirming your account terms with Halden Fabrics: Cavalier grey flannel at 46 pounds per metre remains our current price, Lomond navy twill at 68 pounds per metre.
Booked Theo Marsden's baste fitting for 18 September at 14:00 in the Fitting Room; confirmed with Theo by phone.
Nora Vashti: please move my trouser fitting to the following week.
Small correction to our price list: Cavalier grey flannel is now 52 pounds per metre, effective from this week. Lomond navy twill stays at 68 pounds per metre. Apologies for any confusion.
Ordered 40 natural horn buttons at 24 ligne from Brice Buttons at 1.20 pounds each, 48 pounds total, for Theo Marsden's suit.
Heads up from Brandt Silks: our navy silk lining goes to 41 pounds per metre for new orders placed after 1 November.
Baste fitting went well. For the final fitting I'm free in the weeks of 19 October or 26 October; mornings or early afternoons both fine. Wedding is 24 October, so the earlier the better.
Workshop minutes: Theo's suit on track, lining and buttons received, buttonholes to be worked in the first October week.
Luca: buttonholes finished on Theo's jacket; it hangs ready for the final fitting and pressing.
To-do: confirm final fitting date with Theo and get the suit pressed before the wedding on 24 October.
Greta Ono: the coat repair looks wonderful, thank you. Invoice when convenient.
Mira: October invoices ready to send; nothing pending sign-off this week.
